videos.title: Inside Africa's Data Centers Revolution | Bloomberg Next Africa
videos.description:
Africa’s digital economy is entering a new era, fueled by rapid growth in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and demand for reliable digital infrastructure. In this episode of Bloomberg Next Africa, industry leaders explore the opportunities, investment trends and challenges shaping the continent's data centers revolution. The discussion examines how AI adoption, energy availability, sustainability and infrastructure development will define the future of Africa’s digital ecosystem and help unlock the continent’s next wave of growth. The episode features: Jan Hnizdo, CEO of Teraco; James Manyika, SVP of Research & Technology at Google; Johnson Agogbua, Founder & CEO of Kasi Cloud; Robert Skjodt, CEO of Raxio Group.

videos.title: LIVE: Venezuelans attend mass in honor of twin earthquake victims
videos.description:
Venezuelans attend a mass in honor of those killed in the twin earthquakes that struck the country on June 24.

The magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 quakes killed more than 5,000 people, according to authorities, and caused widespread damage to homes, infrastructure and other buildings across northern Venezuela, including in the capital, Caracas. The government estimates that nearly 17,000 people were injured and almost 18,000 remain homeless

videos.title: How Ukraine Is Stopping 90% of Russia's Drones | WSJ
videos.description:
As Russia launches its largest aerial attacks of the war, overwhelming Ukrainian defenses with thousands of one-way attack drones and hundreds of advanced missiles, clearing the sky has become a key priority.

Four years into the war, Ukraine has developed its expertise in dealing with waves of Shahed-type drones, using machine guns, helicopters and electronic warfare to destroy them. Now, as Kyiv appeals to allies for Patriot interceptors to shoot down missiles, it’s leaning on cheap drones to defend cities from drone swarms.

WSJ got exclusive access to film the teams of pilots and navigators in the Lasar’s Group of the National Guard of Ukraine who are pivoting from attacks on Russian heavy equipment to hunting their drones.

videos.title: Why Microsoft's $80B Xbox Bet Backfired | WSJ What Went Wrong
videos.description:
Microsoft’s Xbox bet on a subscription service called Game Pass after struggling to keep up in the console market. The company spent more than $80 billion to bring major franchises like “Call of Duty” and “Fallout” onto the platform. Now Xbox is laying off about 3,200 employees and divesting five game studios, with CEO Asha Sharma calling for a “reset” of the business.

WSJ explores what went wrong, and what the future holds for fan-favorite franchises.

videos.title: The Race to Commercialize the World’s Most Powerful Psychedelic | WSJ
videos.description:
An obscure and extremely powerful psychedelic drug called 5-MeO-DMT, or BUFO, is drawing intense interest from the pharmaceutical industry, where biotech companies like AtaiBeckley and GH Research are racing to turn it into a commercially available treatment for severe mental health disorders, like depression, anxiety and PTSD. 

WSJ took an inside look at how the psychedelic is being used at unregulated clinics in Mexico, and why companies are betting that it could soon turn into a billion dollar blockbuster drug.
